visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long wavy dark hair, wearing a denim shirt over a black t-shirt and a star-shaped necklace, stands in a kitchen holding three green lemons. He looks directly at the camera with an expressive, energetic facial expression. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a microwave showing dark food stains on the glass turntable. Text overlays describe the problem. (3) The man leans closer to the microwave with a skeptical, wide-eyed look, questioning the method. (4) A top-down shot shows hands slicing a lemon into circular pieces on an orange cutting board, placing them into a white bowl, and pouring water over them from a transparent pitcher. (5) The man carries the bowl, places it inside the microwave, and operates the control panel. He looks at the camera while crouching, expressing doubt about the result. (6) After the timer finishes, he sits on the floor, holding a white paper towel. He opens the microwave and wipes the interior wall, showing the brown dirt removed onto the towel. His facial expression is one of exaggerated shock and delight. (7) The camera shows a close-up of the now-clean, shiny microwave interior. The man leans in to sniff the air inside, smiling and nodding in satisfaction. (8) The man points toward the viewer with a friendly smile, encouraging sharing the tip, while standing in front of the kitchen shelves.
